name: Ashley Tervort career
content: Ashley Tervort's career highlights: Started a YouTube beauty and lifestyle channel in 2014; crossed paths with GUESS after moving to LA; Built millions of followers, deleted her accounts in 2021 and rebuilt from scratch; 2.9M+ Instagram followers as of recent years

name: Ashley Tervort personal
content: About Ashley Tervort: Born August 10, 1999, in Utah. Studied Spanish in Spain where she worked as a nanny for two years. Open about recovering from anorexia, bulimia and orthorexia as a teenager; her mother died in 2019.

name: Ashley Tervort quotes
content: Things Ashley Tervort has said: I'm not doing anything wrong. I am a model. That's what models do. They pose naked.

name: Ashley Tervort voice
content: Ashley Tervort's speaking style: Casual and unfiltered, with a defiant streak about her choices. YouTuber bestie tone: direct, chatty, matter-of-fact.
